steps.text: User opens the platform and lands on Overview with All Clinics or their default clinic selected.
The KPI strip loads current red and amber indicators; the user selects a card such as “Doctor pay blocked”.
A filtered detail drawer opens showing affected clinic, pay period, blocker, owner and due date.
The user clicks Open Source Record and is taken to the relevant module and exact item.
After the item is resolved, the dashboard status updates and the activity remains in history.
User opens Clinic Health and selects the comparison period.
The page displays clinic cards ordered by risk or score.
User selects two or more clinics and clicks Compare.
A comparison view shows KPI definitions, current value, trend, threshold and underlying exceptions.
User clicks Create Management Action on a weak area, assigns an owner and due date, and the action appears in Action Inbox.
User opens Reports and chooses Monthly Operations Pack.
A preview shows included clinics, period, KPI sections, unresolved risks and commentary fields.
User adds management commentary and excludes any section they are not authorised to share.
User clicks Generate Report, reviews the final preview and exports the approved pack.
The generated report is stored in report history with creator, date and filters.
User signs in and lands on My Day for the default clinic and current date.
The page displays today's shift, clocking status, opening/closing duty, checklists, tasks, training and alerts.
The user selects the next required action, such as Clock In, Start Opening Checklist or View Shift.
Completed items leave the urgent area and remain visible in the daily timeline.
Unfinished items are included in the next handover or manager exception queue.
The user may switch clinic or date only where access permits.
User opens Approvals and filters by clinic or module.
User selects an item; the right panel displays summary, evidence, prior comments and decision impact.
User clicks Approve or Request Changes.
A confirmation modal shows any downstream effect, such as publishing a roster or moving a pay run forward.
The decision is saved, the source record changes status and affected users receive notification.
User opens Exceptions and selects an attendance or checklist exception.
The panel shows the exception reason, affected workflow and blocking consequence.
User chooses Resolve, Reassign or Open Source depending on authority.
If an override is used, the user enters a mandatory reason and confirms the risk.
The item leaves the active queue only when the source record is no longer blocked.
A manager opens Team Queue and sorts by days overdue.
The manager selects one or more items and clicks Escalate.
The escalation modal requires escalation owner, reason, new due date and notification recipients.
The items move to Escalations and display the escalation level.
When resolved, the history records original owner, escalation and final outcome.
Approver opens Delegations and clicks Create Delegation.
The approver selects the delegate, relevant modules, clinics, authority level and start/end dates.
A preview lists approvals and queues that will redirect.
Higher-risk or broad delegations are submitted for owner approval.
During the active period, the delegate sees eligible actions labelled Acting on behalf of.
The delegation ends automatically or may be ended early with a reason.
A post-delegation report shows all decisions taken, unresolved items and any exceptions.
Administrator opens Clinics and clicks Add Clinic.
A stepper opens for Identity, Contact, Hours, Rooms, Responsibilities and Alerts.
Administrator assigns responsible manager, nurse and escalation contacts.
A review screen highlights missing mandatory information.
Administrator clicks Activate Clinic; the clinic becomes selectable in approved modules.
Administrator opens Users and clicks Invite User.
The form captures identity, contact, user type and employment relationship.
Administrator selects one or more clinics and assigns a role template.
A permission preview shows what the user can view and change.
Administrator confirms the invitation; the user remains Pending until activation requirements are met.
Manager opens a user profile and clicks Suspend or Start Offboarding.
A modal asks for effective date, reason and whether temporary or permanent.
The system displays impacted shifts, tasks, approvals, remote access and sensitive permissions.
Manager reassigns owned work and confirms access removal checklist.
The user is prevented from new activity while historical records remain visible.
Authorised reviewer opens Access Reviews and selects clinic and review period.
The page lists active users, last activity, roles, sensitive permissions and exceptions.
Reviewer confirms, changes or removes each questionable permission.
Reviewer adds an overall sign-off comment and completes the review.
A review report is stored and unresolved changes enter Action Inbox.

brdWorkflows.title: First-Time Access, Sign-In Recovery and Account Lockout

steps.text: Invited user opens the invitation and confirms identity.
User creates sign-in details and completes required security setup.
A preview shows assigned clinics, role and permitted modules.
User accepts required privacy, security and acceptable-use acknowledgements.
User completes any mandatory profile setup and enters a guided first-use tour.
If access fails later, the user selects Reset Password, Unlock Account or Contact Administrator.
Sensitive recovery requests enter the administrator queue and are closed only after identity and authority are confirmed.
Approver opens Delegations and clicks Create Delegation.
The approver selects the delegate, relevant modules, clinics, authority level and start/end dates.
A preview lists approvals and queues that will redirect.
Higher-risk or broad delegations are submitted for owner approval.
During the active period, the delegate sees eligible actions labelled Acting on behalf of.
The delegation ends automatically or may be ended early with a reason.
A post-delegation report shows all decisions taken, unresolved items and any exceptions.

brdWorkflows.title: Clinic Opening, Relocation, Temporary Closure and Permanent Closure

steps.text: Authorised user selects Start Clinic Transition and chooses the transition type.

The guided impact assessment identifies affected staff, doctors, future rosters, assets, stock, suppliers, phone/website services, policies, accreditation evidence, tickets, incidents and pay responsibilities.
Actions, owners and due dates are assigned for each affected area.
Communications are drafted, reviewed and approved for relevant audiences.
Staff, doctors, assets, stock, contracts and open responsibilities are transferred, suspended or closed.
The readiness dashboard is reviewed and unresolved blockers are escalated.
Final approver confirms the effective date and changes the clinic status.
Historical records remain available under the former location and the transition receives a post-change review.

brdWorkflows.title: Workforce Data Access and Correction Request

steps.text: User opens self-service and submits an access or correction request.
The request identifies the record/category and explains the requested correction where applicable.
Authorised owner reviews identity, scope, sensitivity and any linked legal/retention restriction.
For access, permitted information is prepared and restricted third-party or sensitive information is excluded where appropriate.
For correction, the source owner approves, rejects or requests evidence.
Approved correction updates the source record through normal version/history rules.
The user receives the outcome, reason and completion date.
The request closes with a retained response history.
HR user opens Staff Directory and clicks Add Staff.
The wizard opens at Basic Details; the user enters name, contact, emergency contact and preferred communication.
Employment & Locations captures role, employment type, default clinic, additional clinics, start date and manager.
Award & Pay Profile captures approved classification mapping without duplicating payroll calculations.
Documents & Readiness shows required uploads and training; the profile can be saved as Draft.
Reviewer clicks Activate once mandatory items are complete; the person becomes selectable for permitted rosters and tasks.
Authorised user opens Doctor Directory and clicks Add Doctor.
The wizard captures business identity, ABN/GST status, contact, payment email and clinic assignments.
Contract & Payment captures percentage or agreed rule, effective date, payment cycle and bank details with restricted visibility.
Credentials captures required evidence and expiry dates.
A review screen shows Doctor Pay and BBPIP readiness.
Approver activates the profile; future transactions use the effective contract rule.
Staff member opens Leave / Away Days and clicks Request Leave.
The form captures dates, type, notes and attachment where required.
A coverage preview shows rostered shifts and potential gaps.
Manager receives an Action Inbox approval and approves, rejects or requests changes.
Approved leave updates the calendar and triggers roster warnings for affected planning periods.
The expiry dashboard flags an approaching certificate or credential.
Owner clicks Send Reminder or opens the person’s document panel.
Staff/doctor uploads replacement evidence and submits it for review.
Reviewer verifies dates and status, then approves or rejects with reason.
The new version becomes Current; the prior version remains in history.
Manager clicks Start Offboarding from the profile.
The checklist identifies future shifts, open tasks, approvals, training, assets, remote access and sensitive permissions.
Owners are assigned for reassignment, asset return and document completion.
Access is suspended on the effective date and open work is reassigned.
Reviewer signs off the checklist and the profile becomes Archived while history remains reportable.

brdWorkflows.title: Leave Amendment, Cancellation and Return to Work

steps.text: Staff member opens approved leave and selects Amend or Cancel.
The page displays affected rosters, duties and pay periods.
The staff member enters the requested change and submits it.
Manager approves, rejects or requests changes after reviewing coverage and payroll impact.
Approved changes update the leave calendar and create roster/pay warnings where required.
On return, the staff member or manager completes Return to Work confirmation where applicable.
Any temporary restrictions or follow-up actions are recorded with controlled visibility and an end/review date.

brdWorkflows.title: Worker Transfer, Promotion and Employment Change

steps.text: HR opens the worker profile and clicks Start Employment Change.
User selects transfer, promotion, role change, manager change, employment-type change or clinic reassignment.
The impact panel identifies permissions, roster, training, award/pay and work-ownership consequences.
Required new documents, training and approvals are assigned.
Approvers review the before-and-after summary and effective date.
On approval, the new arrangement becomes active on the effective date.
Previous arrangements remain visible in history and affected users receive notifications.
Reminder actions are issued before expiry according to the credential rule.
If the credential expires, the profile changes to Not Ready or Restricted for affected duties.
The manager reviews future rosters, checklists and responsibilities impacted by the expiry.
Manager removes/reassigns affected work, suspends eligibility or records an authorised temporary exception.
The worker uploads updated evidence and submits it for verification.
Reviewer approves or rejects the renewal.
On approval, the credential becomes Current and eligible duties are reactivated from the approved date.

brdWorkflows.title: Doctor Bank Detail Change and Verification

steps.text: Doctor or authorised finance user clicks Request Bank Detail Change.
New details are entered and remain Pending Verification; approved current details remain active.
The approved verification procedure is completed and evidence/reference is recorded.
Where required, a second authorised approver confirms or rejects the change.
The effective date is set and the doctor receives confirmation through the approved channel.
Doctor Pay displays a warning for pay runs affected by the change date.
Previous details remain restricted in effective-dated history.

brdWorkflows.title: Workforce Data Access and Correction Request

steps.text: User opens self-service and submits an access or correction request.
The request identifies the record/category and explains the requested correction where applicable.
Authorised owner reviews identity, scope, sensitivity and any linked legal/retention restriction.
For access, permitted information is prepared and restricted third-party or sensitive information is excluded where appropriate.
For correction, the source owner approves, rejects or requests evidence.
Approved correction updates the source record through normal version/history rules.
The user receives the outcome, reason and completion date.
The request closes with a retained response history.
Manager opens Week View and selects clinic, week and role view.
Manager copies a prior week or starts from a template.
Shifts are added or adjusted and staff are assigned from an eligibility list.
Manager clicks Validate Roster; blocking issues and warnings appear in a drawer.
Manager resolves gaps or records authorised overrides.
Manager clicks Publish, confirms notification recipients and the roster becomes visible to staff.
Staff member opens My Roster, selects a shift and clicks Request Swap / Release.
The request drawer shows eligible replacement staff and the duties that will transfer.
Staff member selects a proposed replacement, adds reason and submits.
Replacement acceptance is captured where required, then the manager reviews warnings and impact.
On approval, the published roster changes, duties transfer and affected users are notified.
Manager clicks Emergency Change on the affected shift.
The modal requires emergency reason, replacement, timing and approver.
The page shows conflicts, hours and duty impact but permits an authorised override.
Manager confirms; notifications are sent immediately.
The change is tagged Emergency and appears in the stability report and audit history.

brdWorkflows.title: Open Shift and Urgent Coverage Broadcast

steps.text: Manager selects an uncovered shift and clicks Create Open Shift.
Eligible staff are filtered using role, clinic access, availability, leave, training status, current hours and conflicts.
Manager selects the offer audience and response deadline.
Eligible staff receive the offer and choose Accept or Decline.
If multiple staff accept, the manager reviews suitability and selects the final assignment.
Roster validation checks conflicts, hours and transferred duties.
The manager confirms the assignment; the roster and opening/closing responsibilities update and all affected users are notified.
Staff member opens My Clock and sees the current rostered shift.
Staff clicks Clock In; the screen confirms clinic, shift and timestamp.
During the shift, Start Break and End Break update the live status.
At completion, staff clicks Clock Out and reviews the shift summary.
A clean shift moves automatically to the manager’s timesheet review without an exception.
Staff member clicks Report Missed Punch and selects the affected shift.
The form captures missing event, proposed time, reason and optional evidence.
Manager receives an exception item and compares roster, recorded events and note.
Manager approves, adjusts or rejects the proposed correction with reason.
The timesheet recalculates and the decision is retained in Approval History.
Manager opens Timesheets for the pay period and filters to Unresolved.
The screen groups clean timesheets and exception-affected timesheets.
Manager bulk-approves clean records, then opens each exception for decision.
When all blockers are resolved, manager clicks Approve Period.
Payroll users see the location as Ready in Staff Pay.
Payroll user selects the pay period and clicks Create Pay Run.
The module loads approved attendance, leave and current classification mappings.
The control tower identifies clinics and staff that are Ready or Blocked.
Payroll user resolves exceptions through the linked source records.
Once clear, payroll user clicks Recalculate and reviews totals and variances.
Each clinic is approved and the full run moves to Final Review.
Authorised user opens Export & Reconciliation and reviews the final checklist.
User clicks Export to Xero and confirms included employees and period.
The generated output is recorded with version and totals.
After payroll processing outside the platform, the user returns and records reconciliation result and notes.
The period is marked Reconciled and Locked.
Payroll user opens History and selects a locked period.
User clicks Reopen with Approval and enters reason and affected staff.
An elevated approver reviews the financial and reporting impact.
On approval, only authorised corrections can be made and a new version is created.
The corrected output is re-exported and both versions remain in history.

brdWorkflows.title: Payroll Export Rejection, Final Pay and Overpayment Correction

steps.text: For export rejection, payroll opens the failed output, reviews employee-level errors, corrects the source records and generates a replacement export version.
For final pay, offboarding creates a final-pay action covering approved hours, leave, allowances and outstanding corrections.
Payroll reviews and approves final-pay inputs, exports the result and records reconciliation.
For overpayment or underpayment, payroll records the variance, affected period, likely cause and communication requirement.
The correction method and approval are recorded.
The adjustment is processed in the appropriate pay period or external process.
The original, replacement and correction records remain linked in history.
Finance user opens Pay Run, selects the payment cycle and clicks Import / Refresh Transactions.
Transactions are matched to doctor and clinic; unmatched items appear in a blocking queue.
User resolves unmatched items and clicks Calculate Pay Run.
The platform applies the effective contract rule, GST treatment and approved adjustments.
User opens Reconciliation, compares source totals, exclusions and calculated payable amounts, and resolves variances.
User clicks Submit for Approval; the authorised approver reviews summary and doctor-level detail.
After approval, user clicks Generate Payslips, previews them and confirms Email Payslips and Publish to Portal.
An authorised user completes the bank transfer outside the platform.
The user returns to Manual Payments, records transfer details and clicks Mark Completed.
When every doctor is resolved, the pay run is Locked.
User opens a doctor in Adjustments and clicks Add Adjustment.
A modal captures category, amount, GST treatment if relevant, reason, evidence and effective pay run.
The adjustment enters Pending Approval and recalculates the provisional amount.
Approver reviews the adjustment in Action Inbox and approves or rejects it.
Approved adjustment appears on the reconciliation and payslip with a clear label.
Finance user opens Payslips and selects the original document.
User clicks Reissue and chooses correction, recipient update or delivery retry.
For a financial correction, the pay run must be reopened through the authorised correction workflow.
A new version is generated with reissue reason and reference to the original.
The new payslip is emailed/published and the email log records the outcome.
Doctor opens Doctor Portal and sees recent pay cycles and status.
Doctor selects a cycle to view payslip, transaction schedule and payment status.
Doctor clicks Raise Query if clarification is needed and enters a category and message.
The query creates a finance action linked to the exact pay run and doctor.
Finance responds and the query history remains visible to the doctor.

brdWorkflows.title: Doctor Bank Detail Change and Verification

steps.text: Doctor or authorised finance user clicks Request Bank Detail Change.
New details are entered and remain Pending Verification; approved current details remain active.
The approved verification procedure is completed and evidence/reference is recorded.
Where required, a second authorised approver confirms or rejects the change.
The effective date is set and the doctor receives confirmation through the approved channel.
Doctor Pay displays a warning for pay runs affected by the change date.
Previous details remain restricted in effective-dated history.

brdWorkflows.title: Doctor Pay Dispute, Failed Transfer and Partial Payment

steps.text: Doctor selects a payslip or transaction and clicks Raise Pay Query.
Doctor chooses a category such as missing activity, calculation issue, adjustment dispute, GST issue or payment not received.
Finance accepts the query, reviews linked source information and requests further information where needed.
If a financial correction is required, the authorised pay-run reopening and reissue process is followed.
If a transfer failed or was returned, finance records the payment exception and verifies approved bank details.
For partial payment, the paid amount is recorded and the remaining balance stays open.
Replacement payment details are recorded after the manual transfer is completed.
Finance sends the outcome to the doctor and closes the dispute only after resolution is confirmed.
User opens Forecast, selects period and clicks Refresh Approved Data.
The module displays source completeness and any blocking gaps.
User resolves or assigns gaps, then clicks Run Forecast.
The estimate displays by clinic and doctor with assumptions and confidence level.
User submits the estimate for review and the approver confirms or requests changes.
Approved forecast becomes the current management baseline.
User opens Compliance Gaps and selects an item.
The panel explains the missing evidence, affected period and estimated impact.
User assigns an owner and due date or links existing evidence.
Reviewer verifies the evidence and marks the gap Resolved or Not Applicable with reason.
Forecast confidence and affected totals update after the next refresh.
Finance user opens Reconciliation and enters or imports the approved actual result.
The module compares actual result to the latest approved forecast.
User categorises each material variance and adds supporting notes/evidence.
Approver reviews the reconciliation and clicks Finalise Period.
The period is locked and appears in history with forecast accuracy metrics.
Manager opens Template Builder and clicks Create Checklist Template.
The stepper captures name, purpose, location, role, frequency and active period.
Manager adds sections and item types, marks mandatory items and defines evidence for failed/skipped responses.
Assignment step previews which staff or shifts will receive the checklist.
Reviewer checks the template and clicks Publish.
The template becomes active at the next scheduled occurrence and prior versions remain in history.
Rostered opening staff opens Opening / Closing from the shift card.
The active checklist shows ordered items and required evidence.
Staff completes items; a failed item prompts reason and displays Raise Ticket or Raise Incident.
Staff signs off and submits the checklist.
Manager sees completion status and any exception action in the review queue.
Chair opens Meetings and clicks Create Meeting.
Chair selects a template, clinic/group scope, attendees, agenda and linked reports.
During the meeting, decisions and notes are recorded; clicking Add Action captures owner, due date and linked module.
Chair reviews minutes and clicks Publish Minutes.
Open actions move to Action Register and automatically carry into the next meeting until closed.
Owner opens My Tasks or Action Register and selects the item.
Owner adds outcome, evidence and any follow-up.
If approval is required, the item moves to manager review.
Approver confirms completion or reopens with reason.
Closed item remains searchable and included in completion reporting.
Outgoing user clicks Create Handover near the end of the shift or day.
The platform suggests unresolved operational items from linked modules.
User confirms relevant items and adds concise operational notes without unnecessary patient information.
Each item is assigned to the incoming person, role or manager.
Incoming user opens the handover and acknowledges receipt.
High-risk or unacknowledged items escalate according to due time and severity.
The handover closes when required items are acknowledged, while individual actions remain open until resolved.

brdWorkflows.title: Missed Checklist, Retrospective Completion and Waiver

steps.text: A scheduled checklist remains unstarted or incomplete after the due threshold.
The assigned user and manager receive an alert.
Manager reviews the operational context and selects Complete Late, Reassign, Mark Not Required or Record Operational Failure.
Late completion requires a reason and evidence where defined.
A waiver requires an authorised reason and does not appear as normal completion.
High-risk missed controls create an incident or management action.
The occurrence closes with its true outcome and appears correctly in compliance reporting.
Training admin opens Catalogue and clicks Create Course.
The builder captures title, purpose, content, assessment, pass mark, validity period and certificate requirement.
Admin selects assignment rules by role, clinic or individual.
A preview lists affected people and due dates.
Admin publishes the course; assignments appear in My Learning and notifications are sent.
User opens My Learning and selects an assigned course.
The course screen shows sections, progress and required assessment or acknowledgement.
User completes content and submits the assessment.
On pass, completion is recorded and a certificate is generated or upload requested.
If failed, the user receives feedback and a reassessment action according to the course rule.
Manager opens Competencies and selects a person and competency.
The form displays the observation checklist and required evidence.
Manager records outcome, date, notes and next review date.
If competent, readiness updates; if not yet competent, remedial training/action is assigned.
The competency remains available in the person’s training history.

brdWorkflows.title: Training Exemption, Prior Learning and Role-Change Reassignment

steps.text: User or manager opens the training requirement and clicks Request Exemption / Prior Learning.
Evidence, issuing body, completion date and validity period are submitted.
Training administrator reviews the evidence and approves, rejects or requests more information.
Approved exemption satisfies the requirement until its expiry or review date.
When a person changes role or clinic, the module compares old and new learning rules.
Required new assignments are created with due dates.
No-longer-required assignments are closed with a clear reason rather than deleted.
Lead opens Gap Register and selects a requirement.
The panel shows current status, missing evidence, owner and due date.
Lead creates or assigns gap actions and links relevant policy, checklist, training or ticket records.
When actions are complete, lead uploads/links evidence and submits for review.
Reviewer confirms the evidence and changes the requirement to Met or returns it with comments.
User opens QI / PDSA and clicks Start PDSA.
Plan captures problem, baseline, proposed change, measure, owner and timeframe.
During Do, actions and observations are recorded.
Study compares results to baseline and captures learning.
In Act, the owner adopts, adapts or abandons the change and creates follow-up policy/training/checklist actions.
Nurse records a temperature reading in Nursing & Cold Chain.
An out-of-range value opens an exception modal requiring time, device, stock impact and immediate action.
The module prompts escalation, evidence and whether an incident/ticket is required.
Manager reviews and records disposition and corrective action.
The exception is included in compliance evidence and trend reporting.
Compliance owner adds a regulatory change with effective date and source summary.
Impact assessment identifies affected clinics, policies, training, checklists, communications and records.
Actions are assigned and tracked through Action Inbox.
Owner reviews evidence of implementation before the effective date.
The change is marked Implemented and scheduled for post-implementation review.
Admin opens Intake Queue and selects an incoming item.
A classification drawer shows preview, suggested category, sensitivity and possible linked module.
Admin confirms category, clinic and owner, then chooses File, Create Action or Reject as Duplicate/Irrelevant.
If review is required, the item enters the owner’s Action Inbox.
After filing, the intake record shows destination and processing outcome.
Document owner opens Policies & SOPs and clicks Create New.
Owner starts from a template or uploads a draft, completes metadata and sets affected roles/clinics.
Owner submits for review; reviewers comment, approve or request changes.
On approval, owner clicks Publish and sets effective date and acknowledgement requirement.
Affected users receive acknowledgement tasks; the prior version becomes Superseded.
User opens Templates and selects an approved template.
A guided form captures permitted business fields and linked record references.
User clicks Preview PDF and checks content, clinic branding and version.
User generates the PDF and chooses Store, Email through an approved workflow or Attach to Record.
The generated document is logged with template version and creator.
Document owner opens Review Due and selects a record.
The review screen shows current version, usage links, incidents/gaps and prior review notes.
Owner chooses Confirm Current, Revise or Retire.
If revised, the document follows the approval and publication workflow.
The next review date is recorded and the review history remains visible.

brdWorkflows.title: Document Retention, Legal Hold and Controlled Disposal

steps.text: A document or record reaches its retention review date.
Owner reviews record category, business need, linked matters and any existing hold.
Owner selects Retain, Extend, Archive, Dispose or Place on Legal Hold.
Sensitive or bulk disposal is submitted for authorised approval.
Approved disposal follows the controlled method and records authority, date and evidence.
A legal hold prevents disposal, replacement or other action that would compromise the held record.
When the hold is released, the record returns to retention review rather than being immediately deleted.

brdWorkflows.title: Workforce Data Access and Correction Request

steps.text: User opens self-service and submits an access or correction request.
The request identifies the record/category and explains the requested correction where applicable.
Authorised owner reviews identity, scope, sensitivity and any linked legal/retention restriction.
For access, permitted information is prepared and restricted third-party or sensitive information is excluded where appropriate.
For correction, the source owner approves, rejects or requests evidence.
Approved correction updates the source record through normal version/history rules.
The user receives the outcome, reason and completion date.
The request closes with a retained response history.

brdWorkflows.title: Report and resolve a standard issue

steps.text: Staff member clicks Report Issue or scans an asset QR code.
The form pre-fills clinic/asset where available; staff selects category, impact and description and adds evidence.
The ticket enters Team Queue where a manager confirms priority and assigns an owner.
Owner accepts, updates status and records work notes.
After completion, owner attaches evidence and clicks Mark Work Completed.
Manager reviews and clicks Close or returns the ticket for further work.
Reporter identifies a high-impact issue and submits the ticket.
The page displays P1 guidance and immediately notifies defined escalation contacts.
The assigned owner records containment and current service impact.
Updates remain visible in the escalation panel until service is restored.
Manager confirms resolution, root cause follow-up and whether an incident/RCA is required before closure.
Manager opens a ticket and clicks Create Work Order.
The work-order form captures scope, supplier, access window, quote requirement, cost approval and safety/privacy conditions.
If a quote is required, the request enters finance/manager approval.
Approved work is scheduled and the vendor/owner records progress.
Completion evidence, invoice reference and manager sign-off close the work order and related ticket.
User opens Printers in Inventory & Assets and clicks Raise Fault, or reports via QR.
Ticket receives printer location, model, serial, IP/queue and current toner/counter context.
Triage determines consumable, configuration, network or hardware issue and assigns internal support or supplier.
If unavailable, the fallback printer is displayed and staff are notified.
After repair, test-page evidence and service notes are added; counters/service history update on closure.

brdWorkflows.title: Duplicate Ticket Detection and Ticket Merging

steps.text: A reporter submits a ticket and the page displays possible existing matches.
Reporter may open the existing ticket or continue if the issue is different.
Triage user reviews related tickets and selects Merge as Duplicate where appropriate.
One ticket becomes the master operational record; duplicate tickets retain their original reporter and submission.
Duplicate reporters continue receiving authorised progress and closure updates.
SLA, assignment, work order and root-cause follow-up are managed from the master ticket.
Closing the master ticket updates linked duplicates while preserving each history.

brdWorkflows.title: Contractor Arrival, Site Access and Work Completion

steps.text: Approved work order schedules the contractor visit and nominates a site contact.
On arrival, the contractor or site contact opens Check In Contractor.
Identity, supplier, work order and permitted areas are confirmed.
Required safety, privacy and access conditions are acknowledged.
Work progress and any change in scope are recorded.
At completion, evidence, test results, parts used and outstanding work are recorded.
Site contact checks the area/asset and completes contractor check-out.
Manager signs off the work order or returns it for further work.
User opens Help from any page.
The panel displays guidance relevant to the user's role and current workflow.
User searches or opens the recommended instruction.
If unresolved, user clicks Report a Problem.
The support form carries current page/module/record context and allows description and attachment.
The resulting ticket appears in My Support Requests.
User receives updates and may confirm resolution or provide feedback.

brdWorkflows.title: Customer Support Escalation and Service-Impact Communication

steps.text: Customer raises a support request and selects the affected area and impact.
Support triages severity and assigns an owner and target.
Where investigation requires tenant data, support requests time-limited access with reason and scope.
Customer/authorised owner approves, rejects or limits access.
Support provides progress updates and workarounds.
If multiple tenants are affected, an approved service-impact communication is issued without exposing other customers.
Resolution is confirmed with the customer and temporary access expires.
For significant events, a post-incident summary and prevention actions are recorded.
Inventory owner opens Low Stock & Orders and reviews items below PAR.
User selects items and clicks Create Purchase Request.
The request groups items by supplier and clinic and shows expected quantity/cost.
Authorised manager approves or adjusts the request.
On delivery, user clicks Receive Stock, records quantities and discrepancies, and updates on-hand balance.
Finance/inventory user opens Invoice OCR and uploads an invoice.
The split view displays extracted supplier, invoice number/date, GST, total and line items with confidence flags.
User corrects fields and links items, order and clinic.
Duplicate and price-change warnings are reviewed and resolved.
User submits for approval; after approval, invoice register and permitted stock receipts update.
The original invoice and approved extract remain linked.
User opens Transfers & Adjustments and clicks Transfer Stock.
The form captures source clinic, destination clinic, items, quantities, reason and responsible staff.
Source owner dispatches and destination owner receives.
Any discrepancy requires reason and manager review.
Both clinic balances and the movement history update after receipt confirmation.
Asset owner opens Assets & Equipment and clicks Add Asset.
The wizard captures category, criticality, clinic/room, owner, serial, warranty, supplier and service/calibration schedule.
A QR label is generated and the asset becomes Active.
Before service due date, an action appears in Service Calendar.
Service completion records provider, date, outcome, evidence and next due date.
IT/asset user opens Printers and clicks Add Printer.
The form captures physical, asset, network, queue, driver, toner, counter, supplier, support and fallback details.
User saves and performs a readiness review; incomplete operational fields remain amber.
Toner and service due alerts appear in the module and Action Inbox.
A fault can be raised directly from the printer profile and follows the work-order flow.
Contract owner opens Suppliers & Contracts and selects a contract due for review.
The review screen shows spend, tickets, SLA, price changes, incidents and expiry terms.
Owner records Renew, Renegotiate, Replace or End recommendation.
Required approval and follow-up actions are assigned.
The outcome, new dates and documents are stored in contract history.

brdWorkflows.title: Stocktake, Expiry, Batch Recall and Product Return

steps.text: Manager creates a full or cycle stocktake and assigns count areas.
Staff count items and submit quantities and notes.
The platform compares counted and recorded quantities and creates variance review items.
Authorised manager approves adjustments and the stock balance updates with history.
For expiry or recall, the owner selects the affected item/batch and locates quantities by clinic and room.
Affected stock is quarantined and made unavailable for normal use.
The owner records return to supplier, transfer, write-off or other approved disposition.
Completion evidence and unresolved quantities are reviewed before the recall/expiry action is closed.

brdWorkflows.title: Supplier Onboarding, Quote Comparison and Supplier Suspension

steps.text: Owner clicks Onboard Supplier and completes identity, contacts, service categories, evidence and terms.
Required due-diligence items are assigned for review.
Where procurement comparison is required, quotes are entered and compared against the same scope.
Approver records the selected supplier and rationale.
Approved supplier becomes selectable for permitted work and orders.
Expired evidence, serious performance issues or incidents trigger a restriction/suspension review.
Authorised manager suspends, reinstates or ends the supplier and open work is reassigned where necessary.

brdWorkflows.title: Asset Assignment, Loan, Loss, Return and Decommissioning

steps.text: Asset owner selects an active asset and clicks Assign / Loan Asset.
Holder, clinic, issue date, expected return date and condition are recorded.
Recipient acknowledges receipt and any use conditions.
Transfers and extensions are recorded as new movement events.
On return, the asset is inspected and condition/evidence are recorded.
If lost or stolen, the user records the event and links an incident, access review or replacement action.
For retirement, owner confirms data/access removal, disposal method, approval and final status.
Reporter clicks Report Incident and selects category, clinic, date/time, immediate risk and description.
Urgent guidance appears; reporter records immediate action and submits.
Triage owner reviews severity, confidentiality and required escalation.
Investigator builds chronology, adds evidence and records contributing factors.
RCA/CAPA actions are created and assigned.
When actions and evidence meet closure criteria, investigator submits closure and authorised manager approves.
Manager logs or receives a complaint through the controlled intake path.
The complaint record captures service theme, preferred contact pathway, acknowledgement due and owner without unnecessary clinical detail.
Owner investigates, records communication and creates service recovery actions.
If risk or serious event is identified, the record links to an incident.
Manager approves response and closure; themes feed Service Quality reporting.
Authorised user opens Business Continuity and clicks Activate Plan.
The event form captures affected clinic/service, start time, impact and decision owner.
The event board displays critical contacts, approved workaround checklists and communications.
Teams update status until recovery is confirmed.
Owner records recovery time, outstanding actions and post-event review; lessons create follow-up actions.
User logs a suspected privacy/cyber event with minimal necessary detail.
The restricted workflow prompts immediate containment and responsible-owner notification.
Owner assesses scope, affected systems/records, evidence and required advice/notification decisions.
Corrective actions, access reviews, communication and training tasks are assigned.
Closure requires documented assessment, actions and review approval.

brdWorkflows.title: Anonymous or Near-Miss Reporting and Complaint Review

steps.text: Reporter selects Report Near Miss or confidential reporting pathway and records minimum necessary facts.
The report enters restricted triage with identity visibility limited according to the chosen pathway and approved rules.
Triage owner assesses severity, immediate controls and whether investigation is required.
Near misses may create prevention actions without being treated as completed harm events.
For complaints, the owner records acknowledgement, investigation, response and service-recovery actions.
If the complainant remains dissatisfied, an authorised review or escalation is opened.
External regulator, insurer, legal or other referral decisions are recorded where applicable.
Final outcome and lessons feed trends without exposing unnecessary identity.
Authorised user selects a scenario and chooses Live Event or Exercise.
The plan records affected clinic/services, start time, decision owner and current impact.
Roles, contacts and approved workaround checklists are assigned.
Internal/external operational communications are issued as required.
Teams update service status, risks and workaround progress.
When service is restored, the owner confirms recovery and identifies any backlog created during downtime.
Backlog reconciliation and outstanding actions are completed.
A post-event or exercise review records lessons, plan changes, training and follow-up actions.
User clicks Create Email Campaign or Create SMS Campaign.
The stepper captures purpose, clinic/brand, approved audience source and exclusions.
User selects a template, edits permitted content and previews the message.
User sends a test and resolves validation warnings.
User submits for approval; approver reviews exact content, audience count and schedule.
After approval, the campaign is scheduled or sent and delivery appears in the dashboard.
User opens Delivery and filters to Failed.
The page groups failures by invalid address/number, temporary failure, suppression or gateway issue.
User selects eligible temporary failures and clicks Retry Failed.
Permanent failures are marked for source-data correction and do not retry automatically.
The campaign report shows original and retry outcomes without double-counting.
Authorised user opens Consent & Suppression and searches the contact reference.
User records the approved preference or opt-out source and effective date.
The interface confirms which channels are suppressed.
Future campaign audience previews automatically exclude the suppressed contact.
Any authorised reversal requires reason and evidence.
Authorised user selects an approved emergency template and links the relevant incident, outage or clinic transition.
Audience, clinic scope, exclusions and communication channel are confirmed.
Urgent approval is completed according to severity rules.
Message is sent and delivery failures are prioritised for review.
Further updates and the all-clear remain linked to the original communication event.
For a scheduled normal campaign, user may cancel before sending and records a reason.
If content or audience changes after approval, the approval expires and the revised version must be reviewed again.
If a send can be paused, successful recipients are not sent duplicates when activity resumes.
Monitoring identifies repeated failures and creates an outage alert.
IT user opens Website Monitoring and reviews status, response history and affected site.
User acknowledges the alert and creates a ticket/incident if required.
Updates and recovery time are recorded.
After recovery, the outage closes and monthly uptime reporting updates.
Support user opens Remote Access and selects an endpoint.
User clicks Request Access and enters purpose, expected duration and related ticket.
Approver reviews sensitivity and scope and approves, rejects or limits duration.
User launches the approved session; start/end and reason are logged.
The session closes and any emergency or unusual access enters review.
User opens Password / Secrets and requests access to a restricted record.
The request shows owner, sensitivity, reason and linked ticket/change.
Approver grants time-limited reveal/copy permission or rejects.
User performs the allowed action; the event is logged.
If rotation is required after use, a rotation task is created and tracked.
Authorised user opens Security Cameras and clicks Request Footage.
The form captures camera/zone, date/time range, purpose and intended use/export.
Approver reviews privacy, scope and authority.
Approved viewing/export is performed through the controlled source and logged.
The request closes with outcome, evidence reference and retention instruction.
Manager opens Capacity & Flow and selects clinic and period.
Aggregate charts show demand, provider availability, waiting indicators and utilisation.
Manager selects an outlier and opens contributing summary, not patient records.
Manager clicks Create Action to address roster, opening hours, provider coverage or process issue.
The action is assigned and tracked through Action Inbox and later trend review.
Data owner opens Data Quality and filters to Critical.
The page shows missing/duplicate/stale record, affected workflows and assigned owner.
Owner opens the source record and corrects or submits a merge/review decision.
Reviewer confirms the correction where sensitive or high-impact.
The next quality check clears the exception and updates the clinic data-health score.
Owner clicks Raise Change and records reason, desired outcome, affected clinics and effective date.
Impact Assessment prompts review of staff, policies, training, checklists, communications, privacy, finance and downtime.
Required actions and approvers are assigned.
When readiness items are complete, approver confirms Go Live / Effective.
After implementation, owner starts Post-Change Review and records outcomes, incidents and further actions.

brdWorkflows.title: Failed Change, Rollback and Benefit-Realisation Review

steps.text: After implementation, the change owner records actual performance and any incidents, complaints or gaps.
If the change is unsafe or unsuccessful, the owner selects Pause, Rollback or Correct Forward.
The impact panel identifies affected clinics, users, policies, training, communications and records.
Required approval is obtained and affected users are notified.
Rollback/correction actions are executed and linked incidents/tickets are monitored.
The owner confirms stabilisation and records any permanent revisions.
At the scheduled benefits review, expected and actual outcomes, cost, risk and lessons are compared.
Further improvement actions are created or the change is formally closed.
Commercial admin opens Tenants and clicks Add Tenant.
The wizard captures customer identity, contacts, plan, modules, contract dates and support owner.
Tenant admin is invited and completes clinic, user and business-setting information.
Onboarding checklist covers configuration, training, sample workflows and acceptance.
Commercial admin completes Configuration Review and activates the tenant.
Support user opens Support Access and selects the tenant and related support ticket.
The request captures purpose, modules, duration and required data scope.
Tenant or authorised owner approves, rejects or limits the request.
A visible banner remains during the support-access period.
Access expires automatically according to the approved business duration and enters review history.
Commercial manager opens Renewals and selects a tenant approaching renewal.
The screen shows adoption, open issues, plan, modules, support history and contract date.
Manager records renewal recommendation and creates customer actions.
Approved changes to modules/plan are scheduled for the renewal date.
Renewal outcome and next review date are stored.
Authorised admin clicks Start Offboarding.
Checklist identifies open actions, support access, users, reports, documents and agreed export/retention steps.
Tenant admin confirms required exports and closure date.
Access is suspended, outstanding responsibilities are completed and closure is reviewed.
Tenant is archived with a formal offboarding record.

brdWorkflows.title: Commercial Plan Upgrade, Downgrade and Subscription Billing

steps.text: Tenant administrator or commercial manager opens the current plan and selects Upgrade, Downgrade or Change Modules.
The page shows entitlement, limits, price/effective-date summary and operational impact.
Required customer and internal approvals are completed.
Upgrade changes activate on the approved date; downgrade identifies records/actions requiring completion or export first.
Billing-contact changes are confirmed and recorded.
A failed subscription payment creates a commercial action and approved customer communication.
If unresolved, tenant access may be restricted according to contract while essential offboarding/export options remain available.
On resolution, authorised user reinstates the tenant and records the outcome.

brdWorkflows.title: Customer Support Escalation and Service-Impact Communication

steps.text: Customer raises a support request and selects the affected area and impact.
Support triages severity and assigns an owner and target.
Where investigation requires tenant data, support requests time-limited access with reason and scope.
Customer/authorised owner approves, rejects or limits access.
Support provides progress updates and workarounds.
If multiple tenants are affected, an approved service-impact communication is issued without exposing other customers.
Resolution is confirmed with the customer and temporary access expires.
For significant events, a post-incident summary and prevention actions are recorded.

blueprintWorkflows.title: Morning Executive Review
blueprintWorkflows.purpose: Move from portfolio health to owned source actions without searching modules.

steps.text: Open the all-clinic Executive Health view and confirm the reporting period and data freshness.
Review Critical Attention items ordered by risk, due date and business impact.
Select a health component or clinic score and open its contributing records.
Assign, escalate or open the exact source workflow for each material exception.
Confirm that every red or amber item has an owner and due date.
Save the executive view and schedule or export the approved management pack.

blueprintWorkflows.title: Clinic Benchmark and Intervention
blueprintWorkflows.purpose: Compare clinics fairly and convert weak performance into governed action.

steps.text: Open the Clinic League Table and select the comparison period.
Compare health, compliance, workforce, training, risk and open-action measures.
Open the calculation for an outlier and confirm normalisation factors.
Create a management action with accountable owner, due date and expected outcome.
Monitor the clinic trend and linked remediation until the source records resolve.

blueprintWorkflows.title: Cross-Location Emergency Intervention
blueprintWorkflows.purpose: Coordinate mandatory action across affected clinics with live completion visibility.

steps.text: Start an Emergency Intervention from the Risk Heatmap or Critical Attention panel.
Select affected clinics, severity, local action, evidence requirement and response deadline.
Preview the local workflows that will be superseded or prioritised.
Issue the mandatory action to each Practice Manager and local owner.
Monitor acknowledgement, evidence and sign-off by clinic.
Escalate overdue or blocked responses and issue updates.
Close only after all clinics are resolved or formally escalated.

blueprintWorkflows.title: Triage and Resolve an Action
blueprintWorkflows.purpose: Decide from one queue with evidence, impact and source context.

steps.text: Open My Actions or Team Queue and apply clinic, category and priority filters.
Select an item to load the evidence, activity history and downstream impact.
Choose Approve, Request Changes, Reassign, Resolve or Open Source.
Enter the required reason where the decision changes ownership or status.
Confirm the action and verify the source record updates.
Keep the item active until the underlying requirement is genuinely satisfied.

blueprintWorkflows.title: Automatic SLA Escalation
blueprintWorkflows.purpose: Prevent time-sensitive work from remaining unseen or ownerless.

steps.text: A critical item remains unresolved beyond its configured response threshold.
The platform adds an uneditable System Timeout event and SLA Breached label.
The item routes to the next approved escalation owner while retaining the original owner.
The escalated user receives a high-priority notification with direct source link.
The user resolves or reassigns the source issue.
The full breach, escalation and response timeline remains reportable.

blueprintWorkflows.title: Link and Deduplicate Related Alerts
blueprintWorkflows.purpose: Reduce queue noise without deleting independent operational evidence.

steps.text: Select related alerts caused by one operational event.
Choose Link & Deduplicate and nominate the master operational record.
Review confidentiality and clinic permissions before linking.
Nest secondary alerts as Linked Exceptions beneath the master item.
Use the master record for shared updates while retaining each source history.
Close each linked exception only when its own outcome is satisfied.

blueprintWorkflows.title: Clinic Lifecycle Transition
blueprintWorkflows.purpose: Open, relocate, merge, reduce or close a clinic without orphaning responsibilities.

steps.text: Start a Clinic Transition and select the transition type and effective date.
Complete the impact assessment across workforce, rosters, assets, stock, suppliers, communications, digital services and governance.
Assign owners, due dates, dependencies and evidence requirements.
Resolve all critical readiness blockers and approve communications.
Confirm final readiness and change the clinic status on the effective date.
Retain historical records under the originating clinic and complete a post-transition review.

blueprintWorkflows.title: Scheduled Access Review
blueprintWorkflows.purpose: Confirm that users retain only current role and clinic permissions.

steps.text: Open Access Reviews and select the clinic, scope and review period.
Review active users, last activity, sensitive permissions, temporary access and delegations.
Confirm, reduce, remove or extend access with a reason.
Route unresolved access changes to the responsible administrator.
Complete the review with sign-off and retain the decision history.

blueprintWorkflows.title: Temporary Cross-Clinic Access
blueprintWorkflows.purpose: Support short-term workforce sharing without permanent permission growth.

steps.text: Open the worker profile and select Grant Temporary Cross-Access.
Choose the destination clinic, role scope, permitted workspaces and hard expiry.
Preview what the worker can view, create, approve and export.
Obtain approval where the scope is sensitive or broad.
Activate the temporary access and label actions completed under it.
Terminate access automatically at expiry and include it in the next access review.

blueprintWorkflows.title: Onboard and Activate a Worker
blueprintWorkflows.purpose: Create a complete workforce profile and prevent premature roster or pay use.

steps.text: Create the staff or doctor profile and record identity, role, clinics and start date.
Complete contract, award, payment and credential sections appropriate to the person type.
Review the role-based mandatory document and training checklist.
Assign missing onboarding actions to responsible owners.
Verify sensitive bank, contract and credential information.
Activate the profile only when mandatory readiness is complete or an authorised exception exists.

blueprintWorkflows.title: Credential Suspension and Reactivation
blueprintWorkflows.purpose: Apply immediate operational controls when mandatory evidence expires or changes.

steps.text: Open the credential alert and review the affected duties, clinics and future shifts.
Select Suspend Eligibility and enter the business justification.
Reassign affected shifts and block new duty or pay actions where the approved rule requires.
Receive and review replacement evidence.
Approve or reject the renewal with effective date.
Reactivate only the duties supported by the approved credential.

blueprintWorkflows.title: Employment or Contract Change
blueprintWorkflows.purpose: Implement role, rate, clinic or contract changes without overwriting history.

steps.text: Start Employment Change or Contract Change from the profile.
Select the change type, effective date and reason.
Review impacts on access, roster eligibility, training, award rules, pay and approvals.
Complete required approvals and supporting documents.
Activate the new version on the approved date.
Retain the former version and generate prior-period adjustment actions when retrospective.

blueprintWorkflows.title: High-Density Bulk Roster Generation
blueprintWorkflows.purpose: Build required coverage first and assign compliant staff at scale.

steps.text: Open the high-density location grid and choose clinics and roster period.
Apply an approved coverage template to create unassigned shift blocks.
Select multiple shifts and open Assignment Intelligence.
Rank staff by role, access, availability, hours, fatigue, award impact, training and credentials.
Bulk assign selected workers and recalculate conflicts and cost.
Resolve blockers or request a scoped authorised override.
Publish and disseminate the validated roster with acknowledgement tracking.

blueprintWorkflows.title: Open Shift and Urgent Coverage
blueprintWorkflows.purpose: Fill a planned or sudden vacancy using a governed offer process.

steps.text: Convert the uncovered shift into an Open Shift with response deadline.
Filter eligible workers by role, clinic access, availability, training and current hours.
Choose the offer audience and send the coverage request.
Review acceptances and select the final worker where several respond.
Run roster validation and transfer opening, closing or checklist duties.
Confirm assignment and notify all affected users.

blueprintWorkflows.title: Roster Compliance Override
blueprintWorkflows.purpose: Allow exceptional coverage only after transparent risk and authority review.

steps.text: Validate the roster and open a blocking conflict.
Review the violated rule, affected worker, cost and fatigue impact.
Select Request Authorised Override and enter the business case and control.
Route the request to the approved Operations Manager.
Approve, reject or request changes.
Embed the approved justification in the published shift history.

blueprintWorkflows.title: Standard Attendance Capture
blueprintWorkflows.purpose: Record actual work against an approved shift with clear next actions.

steps.text: Open My Clock on an approved clinic terminal.
Confirm the rostered shift, clinic and current attendance state.
Record clock-in, break and clock-out events.
Review the completed shift summary.
Route any missing or inconsistent event to the exception queue.
Move a clean record to timesheet review.

blueprintWorkflows.title: Offline Capture and Reconciliation
blueprintWorkflows.purpose: Preserve low-risk attendance events during connectivity loss without treating them as confirmed.

steps.text: The interface enters visible Offline Mode and limits available actions.
The worker records an approved attendance event locally.
The event is labelled Pending Reconciliation with local timestamp.
On restoration, match the event to roster and current access.
Route duplicates, overlaps or changed assignments to the manager.
Approve, correct or reject the event and refresh the timesheet.

blueprintWorkflows.title: Temporary Mobile Clocking and Location Review
blueprintWorkflows.purpose: Support field work while preventing unrestricted mobile attendance.

steps.text: Manager grants a worker a time-limited mobile clocking profile for an approved purpose.
The worker clocks from the mobile interface during the approved window.
The platform checks expected time and location.
A mismatch enters the attendance Exceptions workspace.
Manager reviews the context and records the business justification.
The event is approved or rejected and the override expires automatically.

blueprintWorkflows.title: Prepare and Approve a Pay Run
blueprintWorkflows.purpose: Convert approved time and leave into a payroll-ready output without replacing payroll.

steps.text: Create the pay run for the selected period.
Load approved attendance, leave and effective classification mappings.
Review clinic and employee readiness.
Resolve source exceptions through linked records.
Recalculate totals and investigate material variances.
Approve each clinic and submit the full run for final review.

blueprintWorkflows.title: Export Rejection and Replacement
blueprintWorkflows.purpose: Correct mapping errors without altering locked timesheet history.

steps.text: Export the approved run to the payroll process.
Receive an Export Failed state with employee-level reasons.
Open the reconciliation panel and map the external rejection to the relevant award or identity setting.
Correct the configuration while preserving original approved time.
Generate a replacement export version.
Reconcile and lock the successful output while retaining the rejected version.

blueprintWorkflows.title: Final Pay and Prior-Period Correction
blueprintWorkflows.purpose: Complete offboarding and pay corrections with clear history and authority.

steps.text: Open the final-pay action generated by offboarding or a discovered variance.
Review approved hours, leave, allowances and outstanding corrections.
Record the correction or final-pay method and required communication.
Obtain authorised approval.
Process the adjustment in the appropriate payroll period or external workflow.
Link original, replacement and correction records and complete reconciliation.

blueprintWorkflows.title: Consolidated Doctor Pay Run
blueprintWorkflows.purpose: Create one controlled pay result while preserving clinic-level detail.

steps.text: Select the payment cycle and import approved activity summaries from each clinic.
Match transactions to the doctor, clinic and effective contract rule.
Resolve duplicates, exclusions and unmatched activity.
Calculate service fee, GST and approved adjustments by clinic.
Reconcile clinic totals into the consolidated provider statement.
Submit for approval, generate the payslip and publish it to the doctor portal.
Record the external manual bank transfer and lock the completed run.

blueprintWorkflows.title: Doctor Pay Query and Correction
blueprintWorkflows.purpose: Resolve a doctor concern without silently changing an approved run.

steps.text: Doctor raises a query from the exact payslip or transaction.
Finance categorises and accepts the case.
Review source activity, contract terms and prior adjustments.
Request further information or reopen the run through the authorised correction process.
Generate and publish a new version where the financial result changes.
Send the resolution and close only when the outcome is confirmed.

blueprintWorkflows.title: Failed, Returned or Partial Payment
blueprintWorkflows.purpose: Keep payslip approval, delivery and payment exception states separate but linked.

steps.text: Record the failed, returned or partial manual transfer.
Verify current approved bank details and the affected amount.
Record the paid amount and keep any outstanding balance open.
Complete the replacement transfer outside MCOP.
Record the new payment reference and date.
Notify the doctor and close the exception with full history.

blueprintWorkflows.title: Create and Approve a Forecast
blueprintWorkflows.purpose: Create an explainable estimate using approved operational summaries.

steps.text: Select the incentive period and refresh approved source summaries.
Review completeness, eligibility assumptions and blocking data gaps.
Run the forecast by clinic and doctor.
Inspect contribution, confidence and assumptions.
Submit the estimate for review.
Approve the current management baseline and retain its version.

blueprintWorkflows.title: Resolve an Eligibility or Evidence Gap
blueprintWorkflows.purpose: Convert a forecast weakness into owned evidence work.

steps.text: Open the Compliance Gaps queue.
Select the gap and review its affected period and estimated value.
Assign an owner and due date or link approved evidence.
Review the submitted evidence.
Mark the gap Resolved or Not Applicable with reason.
Refresh the forecast confidence and values.

blueprintWorkflows.title: Reconcile the Actual Incentive Outcome
blueprintWorkflows.purpose: Explain the difference between forecast and approved actual result.

steps.text: Enter or import the approved actual outcome.
Compare it with the latest approved forecast.
Classify each material variance.
Attach supporting evidence and commentary.
Obtain reconciliation approval.
Finalise and lock the period with accuracy reporting.

blueprintWorkflows.title: Create, Publish and Execute a Checklist
blueprintWorkflows.purpose: Turn a controlled template into role, room or shift-specific operational evidence.

steps.text: Create or select a checklist template.
Define location, room, role, frequency, item types and evidence rules.
Preview assignments and publish a version.
The assigned user completes the occurrence in My Day.
A failed or skipped item captures reason and can create a ticket or incident.
Manager reviews exceptions and closes the occurrence with its true outcome.

blueprintWorkflows.title: Daily and Shift Handover
blueprintWorkflows.purpose: Transfer unresolved operational responsibility without treating acknowledgement as completion.

steps.text: Outgoing user creates a handover.
The platform suggests open tasks, incidents, tickets, stock issues and checklist failures.
User confirms relevant items and assigns incoming owners.
Incoming users acknowledge receipt.
High-risk unacknowledged items escalate.
The handover closes when acknowledgement is complete while source actions remain open.

blueprintWorkflows.title: Practice Scale-Up or Scale-Down Checklist
blueprintWorkflows.purpose: Control clinic, room or service changes through protected milestones and local actions.

steps.text: Start a Structural Change Directive and select the change type and effective date.
Load protected milestones covering workforce, rooms, assets, finance, communications and governance.
Append local actions without removing mandatory requirements.
Track owner, due date, evidence and dependencies.
Complete verification review and resolve blocking milestones.
Approve activation and schedule post-change review.

blueprintWorkflows.title: Create and Assign Learning
blueprintWorkflows.purpose: Publish versioned content and assign it by role, clinic or responsibility.

steps.text: Create the course, acknowledgement or competency requirement.
Define content, assessment, pass rule, validity and evidence.
Select assignment rules and preview affected users.
Publish the learning version.
Users complete content and assessment.
Record completion, failure, certificate and next renewal.

blueprintWorkflows.title: Exemption and Prior Learning
blueprintWorkflows.purpose: Recognise valid existing evidence without hiding the difference from completion.

steps.text: User requests an exemption against a specific requirement.
Submit issuing body, evidence, completion date and validity.
Training administrator compares evidence with the requirement.
Approve, reject or request more information.
Apply the exemption until its expiry or review date.
Retain exemption and completion as distinct reportable outcomes.

blueprintWorkflows.title: Automated Quality Assurance Training Escalation
blueprintWorkflows.purpose: Respond to repeated operational errors with targeted remediation and controlled sign-off.

steps.text: Approved error thresholds are reached for a user and duty.
A high-priority quality action appears for the manager.
Manager reviews contributing records and confirms the competency issue.
Mandatory corrective training is assigned and readiness changes to Review Required.
Affected high-risk sign-off is temporarily restricted.
User completes training and observed assessment.
Manager verifies readiness and restores the scoped permission.

blueprintWorkflows.title: Accreditation Readiness Review
blueprintWorkflows.purpose: Explain readiness and drive every gap to evidence or owned action.

steps.text: Open Compliance Centre and select organisation or clinic.
Review readiness by training, documents, policies, cold chain, QI and audit findings.
Open a Critical or Attention Required component.
Assign or review the contributing action and required evidence.
Submit evidence for independent review.
Confirm the requirement Met or return it with comments.

blueprintWorkflows.title: Cold-Chain Exception
blueprintWorkflows.purpose: Contain and investigate an out-of-range reading while preserving evidence.

steps.text: Record the scheduled temperature reading.
An out-of-range value opens the exception workflow.
Record device, time, stock impact and immediate containment.
Create a ticket or incident where required.
Manager records stock disposition and corrective action.
Close after review and include the event in compliance trends.

blueprintWorkflows.title: Audit Finding to Verified Closure
blueprintWorkflows.purpose: Convert an audit observation into controlled corrective action and retained evidence.

steps.text: Record the audit finding, risk and affected requirement.
Assign corrective and preventive actions.
Link policy, training, checklist or ticket changes.
Track evidence and due dates.
Reviewer verifies effectiveness, not just task completion.
Close the finding and update readiness and recurrence reporting.

blueprintWorkflows.title: Process Document Intake
blueprintWorkflows.purpose: Prevent incoming business records from remaining ownerless or unclassified.

steps.text: Open the Intake Queue and select the incoming item.
Review preview, suggested category, sensitivity and possible source module.
Confirm clinic, owner, classification and retention category.
File the record, create an action or reject it as duplicate or irrelevant.
Route required review to the Action Inbox.
Record the final destination and processing outcome.

blueprintWorkflows.title: Publish a Controlled Policy or SOP
blueprintWorkflows.purpose: Create an approved version with effective date, acknowledgement and superseded history.

steps.text: Create from template or upload a draft.
Complete metadata, roles, clinics, owner, effective and review dates.
Submit to reviewers and resolve comments.
Approve the exact version.
Publish and assign acknowledgements where required.
Mark the prior version Superseded and retain full history.

blueprintWorkflows.title: Retention, Legal Hold and Disposal
blueprintWorkflows.purpose: Control end-of-life decisions without destroying held or required records.

steps.text: A record reaches its retention review date.
Owner reviews category, business need, linked matters and hold status.
Choose Retain, Extend, Archive, Dispose or Place on Legal Hold.
Obtain approval for sensitive or bulk disposal.
Record disposal authority and evidence or maintain the hold.
Return released holds to review rather than deleting automatically.

blueprintWorkflows.title: Report and Resolve an Operational Issue
blueprintWorkflows.purpose: Move from staff report to evidence-based manager closure.

steps.text: Report the issue or scan the linked asset.
Capture clinic, room, asset, impact, urgency and evidence.
Triage priority and assign an owner.
Owner accepts work and records updates.
Attach completion evidence and mark work complete.
Manager signs off or returns the ticket for further work.

blueprintWorkflows.title: Vendor Work Order and Contractor Visit
blueprintWorkflows.purpose: Govern scope, cost, access and completion for external work.

steps.text: Create a work order from the ticket.
Define scope, supplier, access window, quote and safety requirements.
Obtain cost approval where required.
Check in the contractor and confirm permitted areas.
Record work, parts, evidence and scope changes.
Check out, test the asset and complete manager sign-off.

blueprintWorkflows.title: Duplicate Detection and Master Ticket
blueprintWorkflows.purpose: Consolidate service restoration while preserving every original report.

steps.text: A new ticket displays possible duplicates based on clinic, asset and timing.
Triage compares the reports and selects Merge as Duplicate.
Choose the master ticket and confirm confidentiality compatibility.
Manage assignment, SLA and work order from the master.
Keep duplicate reporters informed.
Close linked duplicates when the master and their own outcome are satisfied.

blueprintWorkflows.title: Low-Stock Reorder and Receipt
blueprintWorkflows.purpose: Replenish below-PAR stock with approval and discrepancy control.

steps.text: Review items below PAR by clinic and criticality.
Create a purchase request grouped by supplier.
Review quantities, expected cost and approval threshold.
Approve and issue the order.
Receive delivered quantities and record discrepancies.
Update balances and retain the movement and approval history.

blueprintWorkflows.title: Expiry, Batch Recall and Product Disposition
blueprintWorkflows.purpose: Locate, quarantine and resolve affected stock across all clinics.

steps.text: Select the affected item or batch.
Identify quantities by clinic and room.
Quarantine stock and prevent normal use.
Assign local verification actions.
Record return, transfer, write-off or approved disposition.
Close only when every known location is resolved or escalated.

blueprintWorkflows.title: Asset Assignment, Service and Retirement
blueprintWorkflows.purpose: Maintain one accountable owner or location throughout the asset lifecycle.

steps.text: Create or select the asset and confirm criticality and service rules.
Assign or loan it to a person, clinic or room.
Track service, calibration, warranty and linked faults.
Inspect and record condition on transfer or return.
For loss or theft, create linked incident and access actions.
For retirement, confirm data removal, disposal approval and final status.

blueprintWorkflows.title: Report, Investigate and Close an Incident
blueprintWorkflows.purpose: Capture facts quickly, protect confidentiality and verify corrective action effectiveness.

steps.text: Reporter records category, clinic, time, immediate risk and immediate action.
Triage assigns severity, confidentiality and investigator.
Investigator builds chronology, evidence and contributing factors.
Create corrective and preventive actions with owners and due dates.
Verify actions and effectiveness.
Submit closure for authorised review and retain lessons and trends.

blueprintWorkflows.title: Complaint Response and Escalation
blueprintWorkflows.purpose: Manage service concerns, recovery and review without unnecessary clinical detail.

steps.text: Log the complaint, preferred contact channel, acknowledgement due date and owner.
Acknowledge and investigate the service concern.
Record communication and recovery actions.
Link an incident where risk or serious harm is identified.
Approve the response and outcome.
Open an independent review if the complainant remains dissatisfied.

blueprintWorkflows.title: Business Continuity Event or Exercise
blueprintWorkflows.purpose: Activate a usable playbook, restore service and reconcile backlog.

steps.text: Select a scenario and choose Live Event or Exercise.
Record affected clinic, services, impact and decision owner.
Assign roles, contacts, workaround checklists and communications.
Update risk and service status during the event.
Confirm restoration and identify backlog.
Reconcile backlog and complete the post-event review and actions.

blueprintWorkflows.title: Create, Approve and Send a Campaign
blueprintWorkflows.purpose: Send approved operational communication with audience and consent controls.

steps.text: Create the email or SMS campaign and select purpose and clinic scope.
Choose an approved audience source and exclusions.
Select a template and edit permitted content.
Preview desktop, mobile or SMS segments and send a test.
Submit the exact content and audience version for approval.
Schedule or send and monitor delivery results.

blueprintWorkflows.title: Failed Delivery Review
blueprintWorkflows.purpose: Retry eligible failures without duplicating successful sends.

steps.text: Open Delivery and filter Failed.
Group failures by invalid contact, suppression, temporary failure or provider issue.
Retry eligible temporary failures.
Create source-correction actions for permanent failures.
Keep successful recipients excluded from retry.
Report original and retry outcomes accurately.

blueprintWorkflows.title: Emergency Update and All-Clear
blueprintWorkflows.purpose: Issue urgent operational messages linked to the source event.

steps.text: Select the approved emergency template and linked incident or outage.
Confirm clinics, audience, exclusions and channels.
Complete the urgent approval.
Send the initial message and prioritise failures.
Issue linked updates as conditions change.
Send the all-clear and retain one event history.

blueprintWorkflows.title: Website or Digital-Service Outage
blueprintWorkflows.purpose: Acknowledge, restore and learn from repeated service failure.

steps.text: Repeated monitoring failures create an outage alert.
IT reviews response history, affected site and service impact.
